nivel.explicacao: The score uses the length of sentences and words (the Flesch index adapted to Portuguese, from 0 to 100). It does not measure whether the subject is easy. Lessons scoring below 50 go on the list to get an easy version, written by educators.
nivel.fonteDaConta: Formula: Portuguese adaptation cited in Martins et al. (1996), not checked.

voz.telaApagada: With the device voice, reading may stop when the screen turns off. The natural voice keeps playing.
